VIA23 M3 land spans (2708,13984,3068,14096) and overlaps p1458 new extent (2716..3068) with zero gap at right edges.

deferred.reason: Fix requires moving p1143 (+32x) and p1142 (-16x) plus ~78 instance moves. Prior trial:i02.ug.leaf_0003.02 applied this and introduced 80 new in-crop violations. Knowledge confirms this approach creates cross-leaf polygon conflicts via cross_crop_first_wins and connectivity risk. Deferred as net-negative.

Violations originate from VIA56 M6 land y-extents (3168, 3808) which are not on the 32 dbu (= 8 nm) grid relative to 32 nm pitch. Fix would require moving p1561 or VIA56 instances; p1561 y-moves must be multiples of 32 dbu but any y-move changes the p1561/VIA56 interaction geometry, risking new M6.AUX.3 violations. Same root cause as M6.AUX.3 complex. Deferred.

VIA_VIA12 cell has M1 and V1 with identical x-extents (+/-36 dbu), giving zero x-enclosure vs. the required 2 nm minimum. Cannot fix by instance moves alone (enclosure is inherent to cell shape). resize_via_shape would change ALL VIA12 instances globally and is not 100%-admissible here. No safe per-instance fix exists. Deferred.

V0 must exactly match M1 width perpendicular to M1 length (coincident edges required). Violations are inherent to VIA_VIA01 cell geometry at standard cell boundaries not owned by this crop. No admissible instance-level fix identified. Deferred.
VIA12 at (8820,13140) not in crop's owned instance list; cannot apply move_instance. Deferred.
